【Electric, high-energy various fusion】

Fusion Sounds from the USA, Poland, Germany, Peru & Japan

This time, we're sharing a transition scene from "Reflexiones – Nil's Jazz Ensemble" into "The Catfish – Peter Herbolzheimer".

From jazz-funk driven by tight drums and vibrant keyboard work to funk where powerful horns intertwine with synthesizers. Enjoy the infectious, energetic grooves that connect these two tracks.
